shareholders.evidence: Our executive team and board of directors are committed to operations excellence, disciplined management of capital and long-term value.

result.analyst_notes: Confident, aspirational tone ('best-in-class', 'industry-leading', 'unmatched') with absolute claims. Lists guiding principles but gives little elaboration. Safety, environment and community are paired early. Voice is first-person plural ('We're proud'). Most commitments are phrased in general terms, with little on DEI or workforce.
